reviews.text: Please FOR THE LOVE OF GOD give us a chat in coops. Even just preset messages will do as long as they're useful. I want to be able to help people in my coop figure out the next step and I can't do that without chatting. An epic research to reduce fueling time would be a phenomenal change, even if it's by 40%. Also, an "I know what I'm doing" button that removes the "Are you sure?" prompt. Especially when using boosts and prestiging, it wastes precious seconds.

I had an older much better review on the game. Don't get me wrong. The game's fun but the whole coop thing is getting ridiculous.
